results.title: Bind a monitor to a model version through the API
results.evidence: no route binds a monitor to a version: `MonitorIn` has no version field, the create route never passes `model_version_id`, and seeding the defaults created 0 monitor(s) with none either. `evaluate_from_telemetry` reads that column to find the stream, so it refuses `monitor_has_no_version` for every monitor in the estate and the telemetry-driven evaluation path cannot be reached at all
